guarantees.claim: The function returns d[1]=g[0] and d[0]=g[1]^g[0], implementing a fixed 2-bit to 2-bit linear mapping over GF(2).

uncertain_points.claim: The function name suggests scaling by ω² in GF(2²), but the constant ω is not defined in this chunk; the exact algebraic role in the AES S‑box is unclear from local code.
uncertain_points.cond: when the mapping is reviewed for correctness against the S‑box specification
